c: Simmer seeds in vinegar, water, sugar, salt 20–25 min until plump, add water if dry; cool.
Whisk yolks, vinegar, sugar, salt; emulsify oil slowly; finish with soy sauce.
Trim tenderloin of all sinew; keep at 0–2 °C; chill board and bowl.
Hand-cut 3–4 mm dice to order (never minced in advance). Raw beef: approved supplier for raw consumption; cut to order, serve within 30 min.
Mix 85 g beef with shallot, gherkin and capers brunoise, 8 g mayo, season.
Ring-mould; dots of mayo, mustard seeds, chives; serve with sourdough crisps (toasted 160 °C 8 min).
deae11f6.st: Tenderloin: 0–2 °C, cut to order only. Japanese mayo: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Mustard seeds: 0–4 °C, 1 month.
deae11f6.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce, sourdough bread) · 3 Eggs (egg yolks) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce) · 10 Mustard (mustard seeds). Raw beef: from approved supplier, used on day of cutting.

2ca5dd42.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 30 g caviar (+ garnish ≈ 115 g)
c: Cook butter to noisette (nutty, 150 °C), strain, cool to 40 °C.
Whisk eggs and milk, add flour, sugar, salt, then brown butter; rest batter 30 min.
Bake in a hot waffle iron 3–4 min until crisp; cut into soldiers; hold warm, max 30 min.
Finely chop chives (no bruising); fold into sour cream with lemon and salt.
Pipe 30 g quenelle per plate; keep 0–4 °C.
Quail eggs: 2 min 20 s in boiling water, ice bath, peel, halve (3 halves per plate).
Serve the tin unopened on crushed ice; open at the table; mother-of-pearl spoon only (no metal).
Weigh caviar in at 30 / 50 / 100 g per order; record tin batch for traceability.
2ca5dd42.st: Caviar unopened: −2 to +2 °C, per producer date; opened: 48 h. Chive cream: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Waffle batter: 0–4 °C, 24 h.
2ca5dd42.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs, quail eggs) · 4 Fish (sturgeon caviar) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter, sour cream 20%)

c: Temper burrata 30 min out of the fridge (one 125 g burrata per portion).
Cut heritage tomatoes in wedges and slices, season with salt flakes 5 min before plating.
Avocado: slice or rough-crush with lemon and salt to order.
Plate tomato and avocado, burrata in the centre, opened; drape 20 g jamón; oil, basil, pepper.
62b94f9a.st: Burrata: 0–4 °C, per date, use within 24 h of opening. Tomatoes: room temp, never chilled. Avocado: cut to order.

c: Cook potatoes in skins from cold, salted, 25–30 min; peel hot, pass through a fine sieve/ricer.
Beat in cold butter, then hot milk; season.
Fold in kohlrabi and cucumber brunoise (2 mm) to order for freshness and crunch.
Sweat shallots, deglaze with wine, reduce by 2/3; add fish stock, reduce by half; add cream, simmer 2 min, strain.
Mount with cold butter; blend in wild garlic purée to order (keeps colour).
Salt cod portions (170 g) 10 min, pat dry.
Pan-roast skin/presentation side down in oil 3–4 min, add butter, baste, finish in oven 180 °C 3–4 min; core 52–55 °C, flakes just separate.
Pak choi: halve, sear cut side 1 min, steam with a splash of water 1 min.
Plate 80 g purée, cod, pak choi; 35 g sauce at the table or around.
49f41a5a.st: Cod: 0–2 °C, 24 h. Purée: hold 65 °C max 2 h; or chill, 0–4 °C 48 h. Sauce base: 0–4 °C, 48 h.
49f41a5a.al: 4 Fish (celery-free fish stock, cod loin) · 7 Milk (butter, milk 3%, cream 33%) · 14 Sulphites (white wine). Menu lists 4, 7 only; wine reduction adds 14 Sulphites.

8ad5c7a6.yl: Yield: 10 portions (40 croquetas × 22 g) · Portion: 120 g
c: Sweat onion in butter, add fine-diced jamón 1 min, then flour; cook roux 3 min.
Add hot milk gradually; cook stirring 15–20 min to a thick, glossy dough; season, nutmeg.
Spread in a tray, cling film on surface, chill overnight.
Shape 22 g balls; flour – egg – panko (double crumb for a thin crisp shell).
Blend black garlic smooth, mix into mayonnaise; squeeze bottle.
Fry 175 °C 2–3 min to golden, core \> 75 °C; drain.
Warm eel under salamander 1 min, cut 15 g strips.
4 croquetas per plate on black garlic dots; top each with eel, a little kizami wasabi, spring onion.
8ad5c7a6.st: Béchamel: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Breaded raw croquetas: −18 °C, 1 month (fry from frozen 3–4 min). Mayo: 0–4 °C, 48 h.
8ad5c7a6.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, panko, unagi) · 3 Eggs (eggs, mayonnaise) · 4 Fish (unagi) · 6 Soybeans (unagi) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter)

c: Clean livers of sinew; sweat shallots in 20 g butter; sear livers hot 1–2 min per side (core 65 °C, pink); flambé with cognac.
Blend hot with cream, then add soft butter in pieces until glossy; pass through a fine sieve.
Fill terrine, cover with clarified butter film, set 0–4 °C min 12 h.
Boil mirin, water, vanilla seeds and agar 1 min; set 1 h at 0–4 °C; blend to a fluid gel.
Warm honey, milk, butter; mix into flours, spices, soda, zest (no eggs); bake 160 °C 45–50 min; rest 24 h.
80 g pâté (hot knife), mirin gel dots, toasted almonds, salt flakes; 2 slices toasted bread.
3d974d9f.st: Pâté under butter: 0–4 °C, 5 days; opened 48 h. Gel: 0–4 °C, 5 days. Bread: airtight, room temp, 5 days.
3d974d9f.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, rye flour) · 7 Milk (butter, cream 33%, milk 3%) · 8 Nuts (almonds)

c: Sweat shallots, add red wine, thyme, bay, peppercorns; reduce to a glaze (≈ 1/10).
Add demi-glace, simmer 10 min to nappe; strain.
Blend foie gras with butter; whisk into the hot sauce off the boil to enrich (do not boil after).
Trim magret, score skin in a 5 mm crosshatch without cutting the meat; season.
Start skin side down in a cold pan, render on medium heat 8–10 min, pour off fat as it renders.
Turn, 1–2 min on the flesh side, oven 180 °C 3–4 min; core 54–56 °C; rest 6–8 min.
Asparagus blanched 2 min and glazed in butter; zucchini batons or ribbons sautéed 1 min.
Slice 160 g duck; vegetables; 35 g sauce.
6fa0314f.st: Magret raw: 0–4 °C, per date. Bordelaise base (no foie gras): 0–4 °C, 5 days; foie gras finish to order. Duck fat: keep for potatoes.
6fa0314f.al: 7 Milk (butter) · 9 Celery (veal demi-glace) · 14 Sulphites (red wine). Demi-glace mirepoix = 9 Celery (menu lists 7 only).

c: Char eggplants whole over open flame/grill until collapsed, 15–20 min; roast peppers 220 °C 20 min, steam covered.
Peel both; drain eggplant flesh 30 min in a sieve.
Knife-chop to 5 mm (not purée); mix with garlic, oil, lemon, parsley; season.
Spread 80 g katak on the plate.
Shape 130 g tartare in a ring on top; finish with olive oil, parsley, smoked paprika optional.
Toss with olive oil, orange zest, thyme and pepper; marinate 24 h at 0–4 °C.
Finish with truffle oil just before service (aroma is volatile); serve at room temp.
18023ee4.st: Marinated olives: 0–4 °C, 7 days. Truffle oil added to order.

c: Knife-chop herbs (no blender); mix with garlic, chilli, salt, vinegar, then oil; rest 1 h.
Cook potatoes in skins, peel hot, pass through a fine sieve; beat in cold butter, then hot milk; season.
Beurre monté: whisk cold butter into 30 g boiling water; hold 75–85 °C; reheat vegetables in it to order.
Rack 1 rib (≈ 280 g bone-in) per portion; brush with Dijon, season, temper 30 min.
Sear fat side first to render, then all sides; oven 180 °C to core 60–63 °C (Ibérico served pink); rest 5–6 min.
Plate 80 g purée, vegetables, rack; 22 g chimichurri on the side.
e0c96b47.st: Rack raw: 0–4 °C, per date. Chimichurri: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Purée: hold 65 °C max 2 h. Beurre monté: 2 h at 75–85 °C.
e0c96b47.al: 7 Milk (butter, milk 3%) · 10 Mustard (dijon mustard) · 14 Sulphites (red wine vinegar). Menu lists 7, 10 (BG only).

c: Whisk lemon, honey, salt and pepper; emulsify with oil.
Zucchini: ribbons on a mandoline, half raw, half chargrilled 30 s per side.
Cucumber: peel in stripes, cut into batons; artichokes quartered.
Goat cheese: crumble or torch-glaze 50 g rounds.
Toss leaves and vegetables in dressing; top with cheese and artichokes.
4fe17f12.st: Washed leaves: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Dressing: 0–4 °C, 5 days. Cut veg: 0–4 °C, 12 h.

c: Blend fish trim, onion, ginger, garlic, chilli, coriander stems with cold fish stock and lime, 20 s.
Strain through a fine sieve; season sharp; keep 0–2 °C, use same day.
Cut nori into shards; fry 170 °C 3–5 s or bake brushed with oil 150 °C 6 min; salt.
Fish previously frozen −20 °C min 24 h (parasite control); skin, pin-bone, cut 1.5 cm dice.
Daikon fine julienne in iced water; red onion fine slices, rinsed; toast pumpkin seeds.
To order: salt 80 g fish 1 min, add 35 ml leche de tigre, marinate 2–3 min only.
Bowl: fish and liquid, wakame, daikon, onion; top with seeds, nori shards, coriander.
3f31761c.st: Fish: frozen −20 °C ≥ 24 h, thawed 0–2 °C, use within 24 h. Leche de tigre: 0–2 °C, same day. Crispy nori: airtight, 3 days.
3f31761c.al: 4 Fish (celery-free fish stock, leerfish). Mayatico = leerfish (Lichia amia); substitute sea bass or bonito by season.

c: Mix salt, sugar and lemon zest; cover tuna, cure 40 min at 0–4 °C. Tuna previously frozen at −20 °C for 24 h (parasite control).
Rinse, pat dry, sear 10 s per side (optional), chill; slice 5 mm.
Whisk mustard, vinegar, shallot and salt; emulsify with oil.
Potatoes: simmer from cold, salted, 15–18 min; cool, halve, dress warm.
Beans 3 min and edamame 2 min in boiling salted water, ice bath.
Eggs 6 min 30 s, ice bath, peel, halve (1 egg per portion).
Dress leaves lightly; build in a bowl, tuna on top, dressing at the pass.
e86a4592.st: Cured tuna: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Blanched veg and potatoes: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Dressing: 0–4 °C, 5 days.
e86a4592.al: 3 Eggs (eggs) · 4 Fish (tuna loin) · 6 Soybeans (edamame) · 10 Mustard (dijon mustard) · 14 Sulphites (red wine vinegar). Menu lists 3, 4, 10 but edamame = 6 Soybeans.

2a4c0e96.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 6 oysters (≈ 90 g meat + garnish ≈ 150 g)
c: Brunoise shallots 1–2 mm; cover with sherry vinegar, add cracked pepper.
Macerate min 2 h at 0–4 °C; serve 20 g per portion.
Mix fresh grated horseradish into sour cream, season; 20 g per portion.
Check oysters closed/alive; scrub shells under cold water.
Shuck to order, cup down, cut the adductor, keep the liquor; remove shell grit.
Serve on crushed ice with seaweed, mignonette, horseradish cream, lemon slice, Tabasco.
2a4c0e96.st: Live oysters: +2 to +6 °C, cup side down, covered with a damp cloth, never in water or sealed; keep shellfish tags 60 days. Mignonette: 0–4 °C, 72 h. Horseradish cream: 0–4 °C, 48 h.
2a4c0e96.al: 7 Milk (sour cream 20%) · 12 Molluscs (oysters) · 14 Sulphites (sherry vinegar). Menu lists 3/6/12 pcs; scale 1.5 g mignonette + 3 g cream per oyster.

c: Wash and dry peppers completely (oil spits).
Blister in very hot olive oil (pan or plancha, 200 °C+) 2–3 min until skins wrinkle and char in spots.
Drain, season generously with sea salt flakes, a squeeze of lemon; serve immediately.
7ec11e20.st: Raw peppers: 4–8 °C, 5 days. Cook to order only.

c: Halve ripe tomatoes, grate on a box grater, discard skins.
Season pulp with salt and oil; use same day (no garlic in pulp).
Split bread, toast or grill until crisp outside.
Rub lightly with cut garlic; spread 35 g tomato pulp; olive oil, salt flakes.
Lay 30 g hand-carved ibérico at room temperature (fat must be translucent).
9e6d1093.st: Tomato pulp: 0–4 °C, same day. Ibérico: sliced to order, room temp max 2 h.

c: Blend kimchi with sugar, oil and gochugaru to a smooth paste.
Toss cashews in the paste, spread on silicone mat.
Roast 150 °C 18–22 min, stirring every 6 min, until dry and golden; salt hot.
Cool completely on the tray; store airtight.
c9eb2cdd.al: 8 Nuts (cashews). Kimchi may contain fish sauce (4) / shrimp (2): check label or use vegan kimchi.

c: Whisk yolks with water over a bain-marie to a ribbon (sabayon, max 65 °C).
Emulsify warm clarified butter (55 °C) slowly; season with lemon and salt.
Fold in softly whipped cream just before service; hold at 55–60 °C, max 1 h.
Remove side muscle, dry scallops on paper 30 min in the fridge.
Asparagus: peel lower third, blanch 1.5–2 min, ice bath; reheat in butter.
Sear scallops in smoking oil 90 s without moving, flip, add butter, baste 30–45 s; core 48–50 °C, translucent centre.
Plate asparagus, 4 scallops, 35 g mousseline; glaze under salamander optional.
88e6b6e8.st: Scallops: 0–2 °C, 24 h. Mousseline: à la minute, discard after 1 h at service temp.
88e6b6e8.al: 3 Eggs (egg yolks) · 7 Milk (clarified butter, cream 33%, butter) · 12 Molluscs (scallops)

c: Reduce mushroom stock by a third; add cream, bring to a simmer.
Thicken lightly with corn starch slurry; take off heat.
Temper the yolks (liaison), whisk in; do not boil again (max 80 °C); finish with butter, lemon, salt.
Cauliflower: florets roasted 200 °C 15 min until coloured; carrots glazed in butter and water 8–10 min.
Mushrooms: sauté hot in batches, no crowding, 3–4 min; finish with butter and thyme; season.
Plate: 60 g blanquette in a deep plate, vegetables and mushrooms on top, almonds.
32a42cf5.st: Blanquette: 0–4 °C, 48 h (reheat gently, max 80 °C). Blanched/roasted veg: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Mushrooms: cook to order.
32a42cf5.al: 3 Eggs (egg yolks) · 7 Milk (cream 33%, butter) · 8 Nuts (almonds). Menu lists 3, 7, 8: no flour roux (corn starch), celery-free stock.

c: Sweat shallots, add Madeira, reduce by 2/3.
Add demi-glace, reduce to nappe, strain; mount with cold butter; add chopped truffle and a splash of Madeira.
Tie 180 g tournedos (centre-cut fillet, 4 cm) with string; temper 30 min.
Sear in oil and butter 2 min per side, baste; oven 180 °C to core 52–54 °C (medium-rare); rest 5 min.
Brioche croûton 8 cm disc, 1.5 cm, toasted in clarified butter.
Foie gras 50 g escalope, scored, very hot dry pan 40–60 s per side, season, rest on paper.
Build: croûton, fillet, foie gras; sauce over; truffle shavings; wilted spinach on the side.
a216bc28.st: Fillet portions: 0–2 °C, 72 h vacuum. Foie gras: 0–2 °C, cut to order. Sauce base: 0–4 °C, 5 days.
a216bc28.al: 1 Gluten (brioche) · 3 Eggs (brioche) · 7 Milk (butter, brioche) · 9 Celery (veal demi-glace) · 14 Sulphites (madeira). Menu lists 1, 3, 7, 9; Madeira adds 14 Sulphites. Garnish (spinach) per chef.
